PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Programme with Breastfeeding Nutrition, Progressive Strength, Cardio, and HIIT Consideration"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Postpartum return to light activity with progressive strength, core reactivation, cardio, and HIIT readiness"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Intro to gentle movement and light cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walking 8 minutes rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Foundation & posture with cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walking 10 minutes rpe 4.5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Mobility, activation, and intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walking 8 minutes rpe 4 + 2 minutes brisk walk rpe 6
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5 reps x 2
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Stability basics with cardio finisher":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          knee_supported_plank 3x6 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Gentle resistance, cardio, and balance":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          walking 12 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds each side
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Breathful strength with cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bridge_with_clam 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          walking 8 minutes brisk
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mky_stretch 1 minute
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Core reactivation (modified) with cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          walking 8 minutes
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor_breathing 2 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Upper body intro light with cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          wall_push_up 3x6 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          walking 6 minutes
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 1 minute
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Standing strength foundation with cardio cadence":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chair_dips_assisted 3x6 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio_session:
          walking 12 minutes (steady)
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 1 minute
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Controlled loading and intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cardio_session:
          intervals: 6 rounds of 1 minute brisk walk / 1 minute easy walk
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1 minute
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Mobility & stability with longer cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cardio_session:
          walking 14 minutes brisk
        cooldown:
          hip_opening_sequence 2 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Return-to-baseline readiness with cardio progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cardio_session:
          walking 16 minutes steady
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretching 5 minutes

NUTRITION_PLAN
  NAME "Breastfeeding-supportive nutrition for 12 weeks"
  GOAL "Support milk production, energy, and recovery"
  RECOMMENDATIONS
    - Hydration: aim for 3.0–3.5 liters of fluids per day, more on training days.
    - Caloric balance: approximate energy balance +300–500 kcal/day above pre-pregnancy maintenance to support lactation and activity, adjust by weight trends and fatigue.
    - Protein: 1.6–2.0 g/kg body weight per day to support recovery and milk production.
    - Carbohydrates: include complex carbs at each meal to sustain energy.
    - Fats: focus on essential fats; include omega-3 sources (fatty fish, flaxseed, chia) several times weekly.
    - Micronutrients: emphasize iron, calcium, vitamin D, iodine, B12, folate, and zinc. Consider prenatal vitamin continuation or postpartum formula as advised by clinician.
  MEAL_PATTERNS
    - Breakfast: protein source + fiber-rich carb + healthy fat.
    - Lunch: balanced plate with lean protein, complex carb, vegetables, and healthy fat.
    - Dinner: lean protein, vegetables, whole grains, healthy fats.
    - Snacks: lactation-friendly options every 3–4 hours.
  LACTATION_SAFETY
    - Avoid excessive caffeine: limit to 200–300 mg/day.
    - Identify food sensitivities; monitor infant sleep/colic patterns and adjust dairy, spicy foods, and gas-producing foods if needed.
  HYDRATION_STRATEGY
    - Before feeding: 500 ml water; during feeding: sip regularly; after feeding: 250–500 ml.
  MEAL_PLAN_SUGGESTIONS
    - Breakfast example: Greek yogurt with berries, chia seeds, and a sprinkle of granola; 1 boiled egg or a protein smoothie with spinach, banana, protein powder.
    - Lunch example: grilled chicken, quinoa, mixed veggies, olive oil drizzle.
    - Dinner example: salmon or tempeh, sweet potato, broccoli, avocado.
    - Snack example: hummus with carrot sticks; almonds and an apple; cottage cheese with fruit.
  SUPPLEMENTATION
    - Continue prenatal vitamin if advised; consider vitamin D 1000–2000 IU daily if deficient or as advised.
    - Iron if anemia diagnosed; otherwise ensure iron-rich foods (lean red meat, lentils, spinach).
  MONITORING
    - Track weight, energy, and lactation symptoms weekly; adjust calories if baby weight gain slows or milk supply concerns arise.
  IMPLEMENTATION
    - Integrate nutrition planning with weekly meal prepping; use simple recipes requiring minimal equipment (stove, oven, microwave).
